fullDesc: In 1609 and 1610 Galileo Galilei used a telescope he built to observe the heavens. He saw Jupiter's four largest moons, the Moon's craters and the phases of Venus, and published his findings in Sidereus Nuncius.
realFacts: The moons showed that not everything circled the Earth
The Church tried him in 1633 for supporting Copernicus
He spent his last years under house arrest
The Church admitted its error in 1992
